HubSpot provides fully documented REST APIs, official MCP servers, self-serve credentials, and a free permanent tier.
Pipedrive offers a well-documented REST API, self-serve trial access, standard OAuth 2.0 and API token authentication, and robust developer capabilities.
Attio provides self-serve API keys and OAuth 2.0 on all pricing tiers (including free), along with an official hosted MCP server.
Twenty provides fully documented REST and GraphQL APIs with self-serve API key creation.
Podio provides a public REST API with self-serve API key generation and standard OAuth 2.0 flows available on both free and paid plans.

API access is available on any paid Helpdesk plan, but requires active subscription and admin rights to obtain credentials.
Gladly provides public REST API documentation and sandbox environments, but requires a paid subscription and specific user permissions to generate functional credentials.

Zoho Cliq provides self-serve OAuth credentials, extensive REST APIs, webhooks, and official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server integration.
Pumble provides a fully documented public REST API and official MCP server accessible by installing a self-serve API add-on available on all plans.
Discord provides extensive free, self-serve APIs and documentation for building applications and bots.

Systeme.io provides a self-serve free tier, fully documented REST API endpoints, API keys generated in settings, and an official MCP server implementation.
BigCommerce provides self-serve trial stores, fully documented REST and GraphQL APIs, and clear developer tooling.

API has documentation and standard REST endpoints with API key auth, but credentials require approval from their team.

Vercel provides a fully documented public REST API and official MCP server with self-serve signup.
Netlify provides a well-documented REST API, OpenAPI specifications, self-serve personal access tokens, OAuth2 support, and an official MCP server.
Cloudflare provides fully self-serve API credentials, comprehensive REST endpoints, and official Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.

Neo4j provides self-serve cloud tiers (AuraDB Free), official MCP servers, drivers, and documented REST/Query APIs.

Asana provides a fully documented REST API with self-serve personal access tokens and OAuth, plus an official MCP server.

API is publicly accessible via self-serve trial, but requires a paid plan after the 30-day trial period ends.
